reviewer.role: Independent exercise-block B agent reviewing root-authored theory

scope: Rendered diagrams of every theory 24–30 and chapter III self-check 1–17 view at 320 and 1280 px
reviewType: Independent visual inspection of actual Chromium PNG pixels
method: The reviewer opened every one of the 33 theory contact sheets using view_image and inspected each rendered diagram tile.

At 320 px the complete viewport PNGs retain native pixels. At 1280 px the complete viewport PNGs are uniformly resized to 480 px wide for the sheets; selected details were also opened at original resolution.
Only byte-identical viewport PNG SHA-256 values within one block and width share a tile. The reviewer independently recomputed the hash of every covered viewport PNG and every viewed sheet.
Label-to-point association, readable labels and geometric marks, crowding, clipping, angle sectors, and agreement with the previously reviewed proof steps were checked visually.
Seven additional native-resolution model, viewport or explanation images were inspected for dense markings, the contradiction caption, coincident supporting lines and explanation wrapping.
specificChecks: The first parallelism criterion retains readable H, O, H₁, A and B labels, equal-length ticks, angle ticks and the later perpendicular marks.
The practical set-square scene shows M on the translated working edge.
Theory 29 step 7 and self-check 14 initial/first-step views show only the given right angle; the second right angle appears at the conclusion.
The parallel-side proof retains M and its angle during comparison; both coincident-supporting-line cases remain intelligible.
The perpendicular-side proof shows the auxiliary COD angle and the second given angle together, with separate acute, obtuse, right and straight configurations.
The contradiction scene has a visible explanatory caption distinguishing the supposed intersection from an impossible combination of parallel hypotheses.
limitations: This record covers the theory/self-check diagrams, not exercise blocks A or B, and does not approve their v2 renderings.
Every diagram view was inspected; only the seven listed full-model or explanation images received additional contextual pixel inspection.

The unchanged 24 compiled theory/self-check lesson objects and five runtime files were compared between immutable candidates v2 and v3, permitting this exact visual verdict to apply to the v3 theory block.
This is a local independent visual review, not an external provider approval, full-course automated gate, merge permission or publication authorization.
